item.title: Hokkaido Autumn Foliage Guide: Best Spots & Time (Sep–Oct)
item.description: Autumn comes first to Hokkaido — Japan’s earliest foliage flames into life on the high peaks in September, weeks ahead of the mainland, before sweeping down to the lakes, valleys and city parks through October. The island’s huge wild landscapes make for spectacular koyo: golden birch and larch, crimson maples and mountain ash against volcanic peaks and mirror-still caldera lakes. From the alpine slopes of Daisetsuzan to the gorges of Sounkyo and the onsen valley of Jozankei, Hokkaido’s autumn is a quieter, wilder counterpoint to Kyoto’s crowds.
